title: Framing

stage.name: Framing
stage.description: The wooden skeleton rises. Walls, floors and roof take shape.

intro: Now you can see the shape of things.

questions.prompt: What does a house's frame do?
options: Gives it structure and holds up walls, floors and roof
questions.why: The frame is the skeleton everything else attaches to.

questions.prompt: Match each part of the frame.
questions.why: Studs, joists and rafters share the load from the roof to the ground.

questions.prompt: Once the frame is up, you can see the rooms of the house.
questions.why: Framing is when a plan on paper becomes a shape you can walk through.

questions.prompt: What gives a shared life its shape?
options: Agreeing how you'll share time, money and responsibilities
One person doing all the work
questions.why: Every couple's frame is different. What matters is that you build it together.

talk: How would you like to share everyday responsibilities?
